text: Every buyer needs technology. A CIO in Riyadh. A retailer in Nairobi. A founder in Bengaluru. But the market is fragmented.
Enter Cloud Quarks, by Redington. It orchestrates it all, from one core. One platform. One identity. One data model.
Cloud Quarks Commerce is live today. It quotes, provisions, bills, reconciles and governs every order, as a running service.

And now, the subject we are all here to discuss. The Cloud Quarks Marketplace. This is what the marketplace does. It helps every buyer reach the right solution, in the right market, on the right model.
Buyers come in two ways. Know what you want? Go straight to the catalogue. Not sure? Start at RACE, Redington's A I Centre of Excellence.

It all runs on one master product catalogue. Hyperscalers and SaaS vendors. Hyperscaler marketplaces, with Anthropic and Open A I marketplaces coming next. Third-party DNT solutions. And managed, professional and partner services.

And inside the catalogue sits A I Exchange, where our I S V partners list their A I agents today. Next, it evolves to bring in agentic A I from Anthropic and Open A I, going beyond I S V listed agents.
From there, three more moves. Rules set tax and pricing, by geography. Storefronts give every market its own store. And models take it to market, from direct to white label.

And underneath it all, Cloud Quarks Analytics learns. Track My Cloud brings multi-cloud governance and Fin Ops. Ree onix powers renewals. Together, they drive forecasting, renewal risk, partner performance and margin integrity.
One core. Two branches. One intelligence layer. That's Cloud Quarks.
